text_summary.body: He returns to the south, but the latter time is not as the former, for ships of Kittim come against him; he is grieved and returns in indignation against the holy covenant.

setting.body: Antiochus IV invaded Egypt in 170/169 and again in 168. Near Alexandria, at Eleusis, the Roman envoy Popillius Laenas handed him the Senate's decree, drew a circle round him and demanded an answer before he stepped out; Antiochus agreed to withdraw (Polybius 29.27). Driver: Kittim (Cyprus/western coastlands) here stands for the Roman envoys.

not_applicable.commentary: Interpretive commentary is recorded on the Daniel 11 prophecy records.
not_applicable.competing_reconstructions: No competing reconstruction of the event itself found in the sources read.
